book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Ɗamti nǝ Mbalǝn ki Zangu Upsi
Age cinisi i hwu' mbalǝn domga ɗaɗanu. Ulki ɗami nisi ɗawai, i Yesu imbe milkushti wasbi, i' ulsisu,
“Ami kub go'kǝ' hwu mbalǝnyi, gaki asǝti mutti maki ngu asi ne'kǝni, ulki ɗami nisiɗawai.
In a zasi sa zǝga libi nǝ kuzǝn u, sǝkǝn ma'mbǝkǝshti libiwai, i ngu nami pe'ni lolu.”
I mil kushti wasi ndǝgiti is ultisu, “A ukǝn tǝ mbalǝn mbi ulki ɗami u nǝtǝ kǝm mbalǝn age'dǝlgǝn u?”
I Yesu ngemsi, “Lǝpa nǝmi nikini?” Is usu, “Ninngi.”
I' ul diɓǝl mbalǝnsu sǝ'dǝm atli. Nǝ'kan lǝpa ninngiyi, i' gode Lya ɗa, iccacali, i'go' bǝtl milkushti wasi sǝ' bwasi mbalǝn, is pǝli nugu.
Kwesen nisiɗa ten ngulen. Nǝ' gode Lya u, ippi milkushti wasi sǝ'bwasi mbalǝn.
I mbalǝn ɗami i kǝmsi, i milkushti wasi yemi is njikǝn dǝs ninngi nǝgunǝ sa u.
Mbalǝnisi sa pǝl zangu upsi. Kal ki pallisibi,
ittege' kundǝlǝn ne' mik kushti wasi, illǝge' luki Dalmanuta.
Palisiyawa ɗǝ Lyap Ye'lwaɗi
I palisiyawa gop ngep Yesu. Tǝn sǝ' cimbǝlti ɗa, is ngemti, tǝn gaki tǝn mbokisi toh tǝn lwaɗon sul lya.
I Yesu mbǝ mbadli lolu, i'usu, “Ya lakiɗa kini mbalǝn kinǝgun ki ngep lwadɗa? Bali amipi' kini, kǝnbǝtlkin lwaɗon sul lyawai.”
Iki is izza'si, ittege'kundǝlǝn ki mal, idɗakaci tiyatǝn bigasika.
Yis Ki Palisiyawa Nǝki Hilidus
Imilkushti was musni sa kan bilediwai, lǝpa nǝm kǝn nisi katl ge'kundǝlǝni.
I Yesu dǝllisi kǝm, i'ulsisu, “Yanǝn lu kizoki, apǝn ɗemɗem nǝ yiski palisiyawa nǝki Hilidus.”
Is shilǝn ɗaɗɗasi, “Is usu tǝn gaki biledi niminɗawai.”
Yesu man ulnǝ si dlimti u, i Yesu ulsisu, “Ya lakiɗa iki usu biledi nikin ɗawai? Hal nǝguni ka manini uwaiya? Hal nǝgun kin ɗa yentiniwaiya? Mba dlwakǝn a ndǝdǝli kikǝn mantiniwaiya?
Dwaɗǝn nikinɗa bǝki enluwaiya nǝ kǝm nikinɗa bǝki kumtiwaiya? Kǝnɗa dabǝtl kiniwaiya?
Na chali mbalǝn zangu nantam lǝpa nantamu, mbutu nǝmi ki yemini ki bigeyi gunǝ sa u?” Is ultisu, “Kutl nǝ lop”
I Yesu ngemsi lǝpa ningi u na chali zangu upsi u pa? Mbutu nǝmi ki yemini? Is ultisu, “Ningi.”
I ulsisu, “Hal nǝgun ma, ka manini u waiya?”
Yesu Ndokǝl Dwawon a Batsaida
Is mbǝkǝci a Batsaida, i mbalǝn en mbǝlli' dwawon, is bǝlti bi tǝttǝnti.
In ngapi dwanisi toh, it mbǝti malgǝn gatli. Ibbezze'makǝn a dwaɗǝn, izzǝ'toh, i Yesu ultisu, “Kǝn ɗǝ ye' ulunya?”
I dwani ya lulya, i'usu, “Ami yen mbalǝn; kǝnǝ pǝti asi duti”
I Yesu zǝ'toh tǝn dwaɗǝni ɗaɗanu. I dwanisi ɓul dwaɗǝn wasi, in ndoki, i'yen lu kizoki.
I Yesu ultisu, “Paltya libi, bǝ tege' yakǝn gatluwai.”
Shilǝn Ki Bitlus Tǝn Yesu Tiki Almasihu
I Yesu ne' milkushtiwasi, is tege' mil gatlki Kaisaliya Pilibi. Tǝn shitu in ngemsi, “Ya mbalǝn ɗǝ mbetǝni?”
Is ultisu, “Yahaya mulpǝtl baptisma; gyenne, Iliya; gyenne ɗaɗanu, si usu nǝm ge' mik nje'shinkǝn ki Lya kǝni.”
In ngemsi, “Kinipa yaki mbetǝni?” Bitlus ndǝgiti i'ultisu, “Kikǝ Almasihu.”
I Yesu dǝlisi kǝm bǝs dlǝmi mulǝn ulǝn tǝntwai.
Yesu Dlǝm Undi Mǝshtu nǝ Tǝppǝli U
I'gop kulcissi, yakǝn mbalǝn nǝn tlebbǝna diɓǝli a ngeti, ma mikkina, ne' bas lǝɓasi, ne'mik bǝtl lashti zhil ki Musa, sǝn tloti, kalki mutti maki tǝn tlǝti lya ɗaɗanu.
I Yesu dlǝmisi shilǝni kan unǝ sǝ'mani ɗa u. I Bitlus dǝlti malgǝni, i'gop matiti.
Ngonǝnǝgu nǝ Yesu yalu kalu i'ya milkushtiwasi, im mati Bitlus i'ultisu, “Pǝlolu nǝ ami sheɗan! Ge mbatlwagi laɓa ki Lya ɗawai sai ki mbalǝn.”
Imbe hwu mbalǝni bi ne'milkushtiwasi, i' ulsisu, “Mul lyab dǝp mul kushti ini, tǝnge' gawasi, a'kan gǝdlǝnnga ki bǝnawasi, abbǝlǝn kali.
Mul lyab gawasi, tǝnholti, mulnǝ a hol gawas gayi u, gaki shilǝn ki Lya u, ziti tiɗa.
Yakǝn ti yankǝn mbalǝn mbi intambi dǝb lǝɓa mus, ge shu ki gawasu?
Yakǝn ɗaɗanu ti yakǝn mbalǝn bǝli tǝn gaki ti'ul mbatlwas ɗa?
In mulnǝ a kubsha i u nǝ shilǝn i u, age' hwon ki nge' ngapti ga nǝ pǝtl bezǝn lǝɓa, yakǝn mbalǝn ma tǝnkub shaki matti, inta mbǝ ge' natl ki mulzǝtti u ne' milshinkǝn ki Lya kizoki.”
